title: Actual reconstruction maps for normalized strict systems
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. On a fixed small skeleton of its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention], put $B_{n,W}=(R/\varpi^n)_W$ and $\widehat R_W=\varprojlim_n B_{n,W}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ be the abelian category of strict semilinear $B_{n,W}$-module systems, with componentwise morphisms, of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and use its unbounded derived category. Write $\mathscr N_W$ for the full subcategory with all transition adjoints $N_m\otimes^L_{B_{m,W}}B_{n,W}\to N_n$ invertible for $m\ge n$, and $\mathscr C_W\subset D(\widehat R_W)$ for the full subcategory of derived-complete complexes [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-derived-complete]. No cohomological bound, constructibility, uniform Tor interval or equipped local model is assumed.

Use the specified adjunction $\mathcal R_W\dashv\mathcal L_W=R\lim\circ U_W$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], with its actual unit $u$ and counit $e$. Then $\mathcal R_W(P)$ is normalized for every ambient $P\in D(\widehat R_W)$. For every normalized $N\in D(\mathscr S_W)$, $\mathcal L_WN$ is derived complete and the actual map $e_N:\mathcal R_W\mathcal L_WN\to N$ is an isomorphism of derived strict systems. At every level $n$, its evaluation is the scalar-extension adjoint $(\mathcal L_WN)\otimes^L_{\widehat R_W}B_{n,W}\to N_n$ of the specified total-limit projection. For every derived-complete $K$, the actual unit $u_K:K\to\mathcal L_W\mathcal R_WK$ is an isomorphism. These maps are natural in $N$ and $K$, with the triangle identities of the specified adjunction; there are no boundedness, constructibility or Tor-amplitude hypotheses.
